intro: Iron ore, fish and gold are Mauritania's main exports, with new gas from the Atlantic.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Iron ore from Zouérat, rich fishing waters and gold are big exports. A gas field shared with Senegal began production in 2025.

chapters.title: Herding
text: Herding camels, goats and cattle remains important.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Mauritania makes and sells to the world.
